paite: Koumau kigenhoih pan nawn dek ka hi uhia? Ahihkeileh, na kiang ua piak ding hiam aw na kiang ua kipan hiam genhoihna lai, mi khenkhat a dia akiphatmoh bang in koute a ding in akiphamoh sam ding a hia?
heading: Paul Nasepna Apiangthakte
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

paite: Noute ka lai uh, na lungtang ua gelh, mi tengteng theih leh sim na hi uhi.
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

paite: Khrist lai, kou hon gelhsak laitui a gelh hilou, Pathian hing Kha gelh hi zaw, suangpek a gelh hilou, sa lungtang pek a gelh hi zaw na hi uh chih chiantak in na taklangta uhi.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

paite: Huan Pathian lam ah huchibang muanna Khrist vang in ka nei uhi.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

paite: Bangpeuh koumau a kipan a pawt ahi chi a ngaihsun ding in koumau kia in ka chin uh ka chi kei ua; ka chintheihna uh Pathian kiang a kipan ahi zaw.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

paite: Amah mah in thukhun thak nasemte hi ding in hon chingsak a; alai thu gelh lel nasemte ding hilou in, a Kha nasemte ding in ahi zaw hi; laithu gelh lel in zaw ahihlum nak a, Kha in bel ahihhing hi.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

paite: Mosi mel avak ziak in Israel suante'n amel a-en sawt thei kei ua, huai thupina amang hiaihiai a; sihna nasepna suang a laimal gelh bawn, huchi tel a thupi a atunleh,
heading: Gospel Leh Dan Thupina Tehna
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

paite: Kha nasepna pen bangchi phet a thupi in atung diam aw?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

paite: Siam louh tansakna nasepna bawn athupileh diktatna nasepna athupizaw mahmah ding ahi.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

paite: Hih thupi a omsa in hiai ah zaw thupina himhim aneita ngal kei a, thupina thupizaw in akhuh tak ziak in.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

paite: Mangta hiaihiai bawn thupi a atunleh om gige ding thupi atuam in a-om zaw mahmah ding ahi.
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

paite: Huan huchibang lametna ka neih ziak un hangsantak in gen ngamna ka nei uhi.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

paite: Mosi hih bang in ka hih kei ua, ama'n zaw thupina mang hiaihiai tawpna Israel suante'n a-et sawt louhna ding un maikhuhna in amai akhuh a;
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

paite: alungsim uh bel hihkhauh in a-om a; tuni tanpha in Thukhun Lui asim un khuhna ngeina hawk louh in a-om gige ngal a, huai khuhna Khrist ah hihmang in a-omta hi.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

paite: Himahleh tuni tanpha in Mosi Laibu asim peuh chiang un alungtang uah khuhna a-om hi.
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

paite: Himahleh alungtang uh Toupa lam angat peuh chiang un khuhna lakmang ahita ding hi.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

paite: Huan Toupa tuh huai Kha ahi a, Toupa Kha omna peuh ah noplenna a-om zel hi.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

paite: Huchi in eite zaw i vek un mai khuh lou in limlang bang a Toupa thupina tangsawnsak zel in, amah kibatpih ngeingei a om ding in hihlamdan in i om zel uhi; hiai Toupa Kha ngei a kipan i muh ahi.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
